issue_context.title: Request to add informers.WithCustomListOptions to SharedInformerFactory
issue_context.body:
The k8s scheduler needs to watch a number of API objects such as Pods, Nodes, Services, ReplicaSet, PDBs, etc. So SharedInformerFactory is a perfect fit to watch/list objects among its codebase.

One problem we're facing is that we want to keep the ListOption as default for all objects except for Pods - for Pods, we want to exclude Pods whose `.status.phase` equals to Failed or Succeded. However, in current api-machinery code, there is only `informers.WithTweakListOptions`, which unfortunately applied the custom option to all listers. So does it make sense to add a `informers.WithCustomListOptions` to SharedInformerFactory? so that it's possible to apply a custom ListOptions for **PodInformer only**.
(BTW: an alternative is to add a "informers.WithCustomInformer" so caller is able to modify the sharedXYZInformer in place)

Ref: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/92682#issuecomment-653734850

/kind feature
/sig api-machinery
/sig scheduling
comments: I rethink a bit and guess `informers.WithCustomListOptions` may not work for my case - because `.status.phase` is not a general option in `ListOption`. If that's the case, `informers.WithCustomInformer` would be more promising.

Actually `WithCustomListOptions` should work since we could use `status.phase` as a field selector, though I decided to adopt `WithCustomInformer` for flexbility.

Since `client-go/informers` is generated by `informer-gen`, ~~I filed PR #92801 to update `informer-gen` first, if that is accepted then we could update client-go~~ looks like we have to update both at the same time, otherwise the tests would fail.
Thanks @knight42 , let’s see how it goes.

/cc @roycaihw 
(since we assigned the PR to Haowei)
@knight42 Thanks. I think that perfectly fits my requirement.
